_note: More people who sat in your seat before you (v3). Same shape as victims.json: their signature cards and traits live here too, traits at min_level 99.

victims.name: Doreen
victims.story: Brought a flask of tea to every session and poured for everyone. She poured one for the Caller. He did not have a mouth then. He made one.
victims.quirk: offers you a biscuit from her handbag, then another

victims.name: Terry
victims.story: Came straight from the night shift and fell asleep in round two. The Caller let him sleep. He is still letting him sleep.
victims.quirk: yawns in the middle of his own sentences

victims.name: Big Phil
victims.story: Took up two seats and paid for one. When the Caller called time, Phil stood in the doorway so nobody could leave. He is still in it.
victims.quirk: calls everyone 'big man', including the Caller

victims.name: Val
victims.story: Ran the raffle. The same ticket won every week. Hers. The Caller checked the drum. Then he put her in it.
victims.quirk: folds raffle tickets into very small squares

victims.name: Shirley
victims.story: Called the numbers before he did. Thirty-one years on the microphone. He took the microphone. Then he took the voice.
victims.quirk: says the rhyme for every number under her breath

victims.name: Malcolm
victims.story: Brought his own dice in a velvet bag and let nobody touch them. The Caller touched them. On quiet nights you can hear Malcolm in the cage.
victims.quirk: polishes each die on his tie before he rolls it

victims.name: Ray
victims.story: Bet on everything. On the dice, on the Caller, on which of you would go first. He won that one. Nobody paid out.

abilities.name: Nice Cup of Tea
abilities.desc: No Faith. An adjacent ally heals 1d6 + Nerve and loses one debuff.

abilities.name: Forty Winks
abilities.desc: Once per fight: heal 2d6 + 15% of max HP and regenerate 3 HP for 2 turns. Until your next turn, attacks against you have advantage.

abilities.name: Stand in the Doorway
abilities.desc: Immovable for 2 turns, +3 defense until your next turn, and 1d6 + Might temporary HP. Every enemy next to you must attack you.

abilities.name: Rigged Raffle
abilities.desc: An enemy within 5 is marked for 2 turns (+2 to hit it). You pocket 5 gold. Adds 5 to his FILE on you.

abilities.name: Two Little Ducks
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Verse: an enemy within 6 makes a Nerve save: 2d6 psychic (half on a save), and on a failure it is dazed for a turn.

abilities.name: Don't Touch Those
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Mana: range 5, 2d6 force, and the target is shoved 2 tiles away from you.

abilities.name: Each Way Bet
abilities.desc: An enemy within 7 is hunted for 2 turns: +1 to hit it and +3 damage from every hit. You gain 1 Focus.

traits.name: Mothers Everyone
traits.desc: Healing you give is 25% stronger. You fuss: -1 to attack rolls.

traits.name: Night Shift
traits.desc: Start every fight with 6 temporary HP. -1 speed: you are very tired.

traits.name: Takes Two Seats
traits.desc: +8 max HP and -1 defense. The first time you are hurt each turn, gain 1 Rage.

traits.name: Sticky Ticket
traits.desc: Every kill pockets 4 extra gold. While his FILE on you is 50 or more, -2 defense.

traits.name: On the Mic
traits.desc: Legs eleven: whenever anyone else's d20 shows an 11, you gain 1 Verse and 1d4 temporary HP.

traits.name: His Own Dice
traits.desc: Your d20 never shows lower than 3. You hate being touched: healing on you is a quarter weaker.

traits.name: Long Odds
traits.desc: You crit on 19-20. -1 to attack rolls.
